name: Small Things
overview: Scripture highlights the significance of small beginnings and faithful stewardship, assuring believers that even modest starts can lead to great increase and blessing, as seen in Job 8:7 and Matthew 25:21. God values the 'day of small things' (Zechariah 4:10) and calls His people to seek His kingdom first (Matthew 6:33), promising renewal of strength and endurance to those who wait upon Him (Isaiah 40:31). Through attentive reliance on God's word and faithfulness in little things, believers are encouraged to trust in His sovereign provision and timing.
